forbidden.name: assistant-execution-boundary
forbidden.comment: Only capability adapters may import simulation controllers; model, retrieval and console never mutate owners directly.

forbidden.name: observer-owner-isolation
forbidden.comment: Observer receives a passive lattice adapter; it cannot import scale runtimes or the application composition root.

forbidden.name: no-circular-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Circular dependencies are a major source of runtime leaks and instantiation failures.

forbidden.name: scale-isolation-boundaries
forbidden.comment: Prevent scale-level logic leak (e.g. Scale 0 importing Scale 1).

forbidden.name: shared-scale-utilities-do-not-own-a-scale
forbidden.comment: Generic scale helpers must not pull in a concrete simulation owner.

forbidden.name: ae-owner-isolation
forbidden.comment: Scales 2 and 3 share the Atom Engine; neither imports another scale owner.

forbidden.name: no-direct-bridge-access-from-ui
forbidden.comment: UI modules should interact with simulation state through the controller or PhysicsHarness, not direct bridge calls.
